def factor_cycle_skewness_tanh(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    skew = ret.rolling(120, min_periods=60).skew()
    factor = np.tanh(skew)
    df_copy["factor_cycle_skewness_tanh"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_cycle_skewness_tanh"]
description: Preserves the core slow-moving return distribution asymmetry mechanism from alpha_market_cycle_002: a 120-day rolling skewness of daily returns captures cyclical shifts between positive and negative tail risk. Mutation removes the volume-concentration HHI modifier from the crossover parent because it adds noise and may impair IC/ICIR. It applies a bounded tanh transform as the single lightweight modifier to compress extreme skewness outliers without changing the rank ordering of signals, thereby protecting RankIC/RankICIR stability and payoff evidence while targeting improvement in raw IC and ICIR. parent_strength_target: preserve RankIC/RankICIR stability and payoff evidence from the skewness parent.
